enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Remain motionless. Breathe. Turn over. Adjust blanket. Shift legs. Remain still. Open eyes. Look at clock. Close eyes. Turn to other side. Pull blanket up. Continue sleeping.

Sit up. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush and apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face and hands. Dry face and hands with towel. Turn off tap and light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl and spoon from cabinet. Pour cereal and milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Stand up. Place bowl and spoon in sink. Wash and dry bowl and spoon. Put away.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet and drawer. Take out shirt, pants, socks, and underwear. Close closet and drawer. Remove pajamas. Put on underwear. Put on socks. Put on pants and shirt. Button shirt and zip pants. Put on and tie shoes. Pick up bag. Walk out.

Walk to transit stop. Wait for transit. Board transit. Pay fare. Sit down. Ride transit. Get off transit. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Walk to locker room. Change into work clothes. Put on badge. Walk to work area. Greet colleagues. Check schedule. Start work.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check patient charts. Walk to patient room. Wash hands. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Record information on computer. Administer medication. Change bandage. Assist patient with walking. Talk with doctor. Attend meeting. Respond to call light. Help patient with toilet. Wash hands. Update records. End shift.

Walk to transit stop. Wait for transit. Board transit. Pay fare. Sit down. Ride transit. Get off transit. Walk to home. Enter building. Walk to apartment. Unlock door. Enter apartment. Close door. Remove shoes. Put down bag. Hang up coat.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pot and pan. Close cabinet. Wash and cut vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil, meat, vegetables, and spices. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Wash and dry dishes. Put away.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and monitoring storm updates
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Use remote to change channel. Watch news. Listen to storm updates. Change channel to weather. Watch forecast. Adjust volume. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit down. Turn on TV. Continue watching.

Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open browser. Read articles. Watch video. Play game. Type message. Send message. Adjust monitor. Close browser. Shut down computer. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get drink. Walk back. Sit down. Turn on computer. Continue using.

Walk to living room. Pick up book. Sit on sofa. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Turn page. Close book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Open music app. Select playlist. Play music. Adjust volume. Listen. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get water. Walk back. Sit down. Pick up book. Continue reading.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on shower. Wash body with soap and rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down and reading before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on lamp. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Turn page. Close book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check messages. Set alarm. Put down phone. Turn off lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Remain still. Sleep.
